sources.finding: Broken-weight report; comments point to Hagaik92/FastDepth, which describes itself as a reimplementation rather than original authors weights.
Several separately trained models are available. Not substituted for the four original FastDepth checkpoints; no declared repository license was returned by GitHub.
Model card links quantized TFLite deployments derived from PINTO. No original PyTorch weights are stored in this HF repository.
Only README and .gitattributes were listed; no checkpoint file.

Converted model archive is reachable (724201074 bytes). Bounded 32 MiB inspection found ONNX/TFLite/OpenVINO/TF assets; the full archive was not downloaded and original PyTorch weights were not established.
CDX query returned an empty result list.

Community fork candidate acquired and converted. Pruned MobileNetSkipAdd, 1360786 parameters; legacy claimed RMSE/delta1 align with upstream references but were not remeasured. Original author checksum not available.
Inspected file trees of the largest listed forks; identified the community pruned candidate and encoder-only weights, not all four original depth checkpoints.
